194:t_3:132.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But soon I won't need that answer. Once we take the capital, the war will end... No... We'll end it ourselves...)

194:t_10:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hup...! Ho...! Ha...! Ta...! Hyah! Yah! Take that!」

194:t_10:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Just what it looks like! Hard work + guts = intensive training!」

194:t_10:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm practicing my kicks! I'm going to create a new move that surpasses $$ノリコ$$'s Inazuma Reversal Kick!」

194:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were incredibly excited when $$ノリコ$$ used that move.」

194:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the squad's stock.」

194:t_10:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So androids can produce $$Ｚチップ$$s too...!」

194:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They're the product of emotional stirrings. For someone full of hard work and guts like you, $$ノノ$$, it's only natural.」

194:t_10:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hearing that fires me up again! I'll create a new finishing move and leave $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis speechless!」

194:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please use the training regimen I've devised.」

194:t_10:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's see... Inazuma Manji Kick, Inazuma Corkscrew Kick, Inazuma Fire Pillar Kick, Inazuma Super-Electromagnetic Drill Kick...!」

194:t_10:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Amazing! If $$ノノ$$ masters all of these, she'll get closer to $$ノノリリ$$!」

194:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Her innocence is delightful... It makes teasing her so rewarding.)

194:t_10:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then let's get training right away! Inazuma Manji Kick!」

194:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The operation was a great success, $$オズマ$$.」

194:t_10:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's thanks to you too. You really helped us this time, $$ＡＧ$$.」

194:t_10:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We could contact $$バサラ$$ and his friends because you tracked down their location.」

194:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm delighted to have helped. That was the power of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ too.」

194:t_10:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「It has that kind of power...?」

194:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$s are born from human emotions. Further refining and purifying them into crystals creates $$Ｚクリスタル$$s.」

194:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, they respond to human feelings... To the power of life, you might say.」

194:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wherever $$バサラ$$ sings, the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ picks up those waves. His songs are special, after all.」

194:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By following them, I can determine where he is.」

194:t_10:33.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I see... So it understands the passion in $$バサラ$$'s songs too.」

194:t_10:35.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If my songs move someone's heart, it doesn't matter what they are.」

194:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, $$バサラ$$! Then let me hear your shout too!」

194:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then...! Let's put our hearts into another day of... business, business!」

194:t_10:40.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Sing, $$バサラ$$... Give $$ランカ$$'s heart courage with your songs...)

195:t_000:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Give me a status report.」

195:t_000:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The detention facility has been liberated! $$エコーズ$$ members are guiding the escaped prisoners!」

195:t_000:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「The assault team and the fake $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ will return shortly too!」

195:t_000:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「It certainly was a surprise to see the real $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ turn up.」

195:t_000:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Apparently Major $$オズマ$$ contacted them independently as his trump card.」

195:t_000:5.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Maybe his desire to save $$ランカ$$-chan and his love for $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ worked a miracle.」

195:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First we'll evacuate the prisoners. Then we'll take $$ターミナル・ベース$$!」

195:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Interceptors, crush $c! Transport, leave this area as a precaution!」

195:t_002:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! It seems the abducted civilians are aboard that ship!」

195:t_002:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「Ensign $$アルト$$, $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$ are aboard!」

195:t_002:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units. Now the real battle begins...!」

195:t_003:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「She can summon $$ディスヌフ$$. There's no way she'd be defeated.」

195:t_003:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「I can't speak for $$ノノ$$, but $$ラルク$$ is the $$トップレス$$ ace.」

195:t_003:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units! There are still civilians aboard that transport!」

195:t_003:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Once it crosses that line, we won't be able to pursue it any farther!」

195:t_004:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll attack the transport's power section and stop it before it escapes!」

195:t_004:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't shoot it down, even by mistake! Remember, there are civilians aboard!」

195:t_004:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Understood! I'll keep the smashing to a minimum!」

195:t_004:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn you, $c! I'll crush you here and clear my name of every disgrace!」

195:t_004:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$... Have you heard the expression 'heaping shame upon shame'?」

195:t_004:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our goal lies farther ahead! Once we free the civilians, we'll swiftly crush this paltry base!」

195:t_004:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You...! What do you take my castle for!?」

195:t_004:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Some castle! You've been abducting innocent people!」

195:t_004:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll make you feel $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s anger for them!」

195:t_004:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Shut up! Earthlings exist only to be exploited! They're no better than livestock! Their anger is a joke!」

195:t_004:11.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This is war! Those who lose have no right to live!」

195:t_005:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「You saved us back there, $$バサラ$$!」

195:t_005:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Thanks for all your hard work babysitting $$バサラ$$ too, Captain $$ガムリン$$.」

195:t_005:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'm used to this sort of thing.」

195:t_005:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That doesn't excuse being so reckless, $$バサラ$$! Holding a concert right in the middle of the enemy!」

195:t_005:6.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「I suppose it's nothing out of the ordinary for him.」

195:t_005:8.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Just so you know, the concert isn't over yet!」

195:t_005:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Sing your heart out, $$バサラ$$! I'll cover you!」

195:t_005:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Wh-what is that man!? Is he going to sing on the battlefield!?」

195:t_005:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ギルター$$! You'd better savor $$バサラ$$'s songs too!」
